verdict.rationale: Rootly's first-party docs cover each element of the story. AI Summaries generates titles, summaries, catchups and status write-ups from the incident record "so nobody has to write documentation mid-incident," via `/rootly summary` or an @Rootly "catch me up" mention. Meeting Scribe joins bridges automatically and transcribes them live with speaker labels, attached to the incident. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the live AI features, and deeper documentation of drafting stakeholder updates beyond the brief "status write-ups" mention.
